title: HR Administrator
company: Cherry Professional - Relationship Led Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Coordinator (Temporary)
Location: Nottingham
Rate: £14.00 - £16.00 per hour (depending on experience)
Contract: Temporary until Christmas Start Date: Immediate
The Opportunity
We are currently recruiting for an experienced HR Coordinator to join a busy and supportive HR team on a temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive HR professional who enjoys a varied workload and can hit the ground running.
The role is for an immediate start.
Key Responsibilities
- Providing first-line HR support to managers and employees
- Coordinating recruitment and onboarding activities
- Supporting payroll administration and ensuring data accuracy
- Managing employee records and HR documentation
- Monitoring and recording absence information
- Assisting with employee relations administration
- Coordinating offboarding and leaver processes
- Maintaining HR systems and ensuring GDPR compliance
- Providing general HR administrative support across the employee lifecycle

About You
To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous HR coordination experience
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
- Confidence in managing multiple priorities independently
- Experience supporting recruitment, payroll and employee records
- Good understanding of HR processes and employment practices
- Excellent communication skills and a professional approach
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office packages
- The ability to work accurately in a fast-paced environment

Cherry Professional are recruiting for this opportunity on behalf of our client. Please view our Privacy Policy on our website to understand how your data will be used if you apply for this role.

title: HR Administrator

description:
HR Coordinator
Nottingham (NG7)
£14.00 - £16 per hour DOE
Temporary Assignment until December 2026
Hybrid working - with occasional travel to their offices in Warwickshire

Macildowie are working with this client based in Nottingham to recruit an experienced HR Coordinator for an immediate opportunity within a fast-paced and growing organisation.

This is an exclusive opportunity with interviews taking place this week and a planned start date for next week, making it an excellent role for candidates who are immediately available or coming to the end of a current assignment.

The successful candidate will provide administrative support across the HR function, ensuring employee records are maintained accurately and supporting the wider team with day-to-day HR processes.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintaining and updating employee records and HR databases
- Producing HR documentation including contracts, letters and employee correspondence
- Supporting onboarding and new starter administration
- Assisting with absence management and holiday records
- Managing HR inbox queries and responding in a timely manner

title: Recruitment Coordinator
description:
- Proactively build excellent working relationships with managers across the business seeking to understand the resourcing challenges and requirements of their teams.
- Delivering high levels of customer service and acting as key point of contact for managers and candidates.
- Co-ordinate recruitment activity from advertising to appointment; maintaining and updating recruitment activity on ATS and ensuring all documentation is issued within prescribed timescales.
- Challenge, coach and advise hiring managers on appropriate recruitment and selection processes, practice and procedure to support successful hiring that incorporates good practice, compliance, fairness and diversity with efficiency.
- Coordinate and manage interviews and preparation to support the hiring manager as and when required
- Processing all pre-employment compliance checks including Right to Work and DBS with a high level of accuracy ensuring compliance with regulatory and legal requirements in accordance to agreed policy, processes and time scales.

Skills required Recruitment Coordinator
- Excellent communication both verbally and written with a history of client relationship management
- Previous experience of volume recruiting across multiple industries and using an ATS system
- Previous experience of onboarding compliance requirements and legislation within a regulated environment
- Previous experience of managing a diverse workload and ability to prioritise effectively
